items.exampleEn: My cat has a peculiar habit of sleeping in the sink.
items.exampleZh: 我的貓有個奇怪的習慣，喜歡睡在水槽裡。

items.exampleEn: I have vivid memories of my first day at school.
items.exampleZh: 我對上學第一天的記憶非常鮮明。

items.exampleEn: Without batteries, the toy is useless.
items.exampleZh: 沒有電池，這個玩具就沒用了。

items.exampleEn: Some primitive plants have lived on Earth for millions of years.
items.exampleZh: 有些原始的植物已經在地球上存活了數百萬年。

items.exampleEn: Don't complicate things; keep it simple.
items.exampleZh: 別把事情複雜化，保持簡單。

items.exampleEn: The plane began its upward climb.
He is notorious for being late.
items.glossZh: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的

items.sentenceEn: This map is useless; it's too old.
items.sentenceZh: 這張地圖沒用了，太舊了。

items.audioEn: The rain will complicate our plans for the picnic, so let's eat at home.
items.audioZh: 下雨會讓我們的野餐計畫變複雜，所以我們在家吃吧。
options: Have the picnic food at home.

items.sentenceEn: The children painted the walls beautifully.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們把牆壁畫得很漂亮。

items.sentenceEn: The thief was notorious in the whole city.
items.sentenceZh: 那個小偷在全城惡名昭彰。

items.stemEn: The story was so ____ that I could see every scene in my mind.
items.stemZh: 這個故事描寫得很生動，我腦海中能看到每個畫面。

items.stemEn: People in ____ times lived in caves and hunted animals.
items.stemZh: 原始時代的人住在洞穴裡、打獵維生。

items.passageEn: Last summer, I visited a cave where early humans lived thousands of years ago. The walls were covered with vivid paintings of animals. Our guide explained that the people used primitive tools; to us, the tools look useless, but they were very important then. Inside the cave, there was a peculiar smell, like old wet stone. We also saw the bones of an extinct animal. The path inside went in an upward direction, so walking was hard. One part of the cave is notorious for its many bats. The guide said that leaving the path would complicate the tour, because people could get lost. At the end, a group of children sang beautifully at the entrance of the cave.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我參觀了一個幾千年前早期人類住過的洞穴。牆上布滿了鮮明的動物壁畫。導覽員解釋說，那些人使用原始的工具；在我們看來，那些工具好像沒什麼用，但在當時非常重要。洞穴裡有一股奇怪的味道，像是潮濕的老石頭。我們還看到一種已經絕種的動物的骨頭。裡面的小路一路往上，所以很難走。洞穴的某一區因為蝙蝠很多而惡名昭彰。導覽員說，離開步道會讓參觀變複雜，因為有人可能會迷路。最後，一群孩子在洞口唱歌，唱得很美。

questions.questionZh: 導覽員為什麼要大家別離開步道？

items.promptZh: 這座城市的夜晚燈光很美。
referenceEn: The city is beautifully lit at night.
At night, the city is beautifully lit.
rubricZh: beautifully 表示「美麗地、出色地」，例如 beautifully lit 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 useless 造一個句子，說說一樣你覺得沒用的東西。
referenceEn: My old phone is useless because it doesn't turn on.
I think this umbrella is useless; it has a big hole.
rubricZh: useless 表示「無用的」，例如 … is useless 等說法
說的是自己的東西或想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
